title: Exercise the removed-root journal sweep cursor independently of authority recovery
outcome: A controlled-clock behavioural test reaches the removed-root journal loop itself and discriminates cursor advancement and resumption from authority recovery queue rotation.
acceptance: A fixture with removed journals and no preliminary authority read consuming admission observes the actual journal-loop NamedRootRead and asserts a populated, advanced engram_root_read_cursor.

A subsequent unfiltered pass resumes from the recorded cursor, including wrap/progress behaviour, and a filtered pass preserves an already populated unfiltered cursor; the tests fail if cursor advancement is removed.
The regression uses controlled clocks, retains operation minimum and journal/read limits, and passes under the standard registered launcher on the reviewed input.
